description: This is a shell script used for managing the lifecycle of the 'mldproxy' service, including starting, stopping, and responding to network status changes. It configures the mldproxy daemon, handles system events such as WAN and LAN status updates, and logs service status messages.

methods.name: do_start_mldproxy
methods.description: Starts the mldproxy service by configuring its parameters and executing the binary if available.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes service variables by retrieving configuration parameters and current network interface names.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the mldproxy service if conditions are met and updates system event statuses.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the mldproxy service and cleans up temporary files, updating system event statuses.
